title: Quantum Graph Neural Networks for Jet Tagging on Quantum Hardware
summary: Jets are central to the physics programs of both current and future colliders, from precision Standard Model measurements and searches for new physics at the Large Hadron Collider to studies of nucleon structure at the future Electron-Ion Collider. Motivated by these applications, we explore quantum machine learning for jet classification and present a permutation-invariant Quantum Graph Neural Network (QGNN) applied to particle-cloud representations of jets.
